demand.criterion: One distinct pipe acquired at the assigned chute and credited at red L1 during TELEOP.
demand.windowScope: Complete TELEOP from its first active sample through cutoff
demand.basis: Chosen role needs two TELEOP L1 deliveries before time expires, in addition to its independent AUTO leave and final park.

scope: Observed accepted events divided by the whole declared clock, including travel, queues, misses and recovery. The lower percentile describes these runs; physical reliability requires physical evidence.
